title.en: flea harvey's art market in the cedars, free all day.
title.de: flea harvey's kunstmarkt in den cedars, eintritt frei.
title.tr: cedars'ta flea harvey's sanat pazarı, giriş ücretsiz.

line.en: 20-plus local art vendors from 11:00 to 18:00 at lee harvey's on gould street, the same day as the cedars open studios tour. breakfast tacos and mimosas, pets welcome.
line.de: über 20 lokale kunsthandwerker von 11:00 bis 18:00 uhr bei lee harvey's in der gould street, am selben tag wie die cedars open studios tour. frühstückstacos und mimosen, hunde willkommen.
line.tr: 11:00-18:00 arası lee harvey's'ta (gould street) 20'den fazla yerel sanatçı, aynı gün cedars open studios turu da var. kahvaltılık tacolar ve mimosa var, evcil hayvanlar da gelebilir.

sparks.why: Flea Harvey's Cedars Open Studios Art Market, sat 21 nov 11:00 to 18:00 at 1807 Gould Street, free entry, per the Community Impact calendar and The Craft Map.
